description: The optimized single-replica engine the fleet is built from: what tpu-onboarding and tpu-performance produced, as one file.

image.description: The vLLM TPU serving image, by digest when possible.

args.description: `vllm serve` arguments after the model name. --port and --tensor-parallel-size are set by the renderer and ignored here.

fleet.description: How the study relates to the model servers. Absent or mode=managed: the study deploys them from this recipe. mode=adopted: they are already running and owned by someone else; the study only adds the router and benchmarks around them, selects them by these labels, and never applies, scales, restarts or deletes them. Any incumbent path that would change them is refused with ADOPTED_FLEET_IMMUTABLE.

selector.description: Pod labels that select the adopted servers (required when adopted).

service.description: ClusterIP Service in front of the adopted pods; the passthrough control benchmarks against it (required when adopted).

port.description: Port the adopted servers listen on. Default 8000.

replicas.description: Pods the selector is expected to match; `wait` requires this many Ready (required when adopted).

role.description: llm-d role of the adopted pods. Default decode.

chips_per_host.description: Chips one node exposes as google.com/tpu. Required for multi-host replicas (topology.<role>.hosts > 1) unless the generation is pinned (tpu7x: 4).

placement_policy.description: GKE workload (placement) policy name for a multi-host TPU7x node pool; rendered as the cloud.google.com/placement-policy-name node selector.

measured.description: Single-replica saturation facts the planner sizes the fleet from.

knee_rps.description: Highest request rate at which the single replica still met the SLOs.

peak_prefill_throughput.description: Tokens/s of prefill one replica sustains; the affinity filter's peakPrefillThroughput.

peak_decode_throughput.description: Generation tokens/s one replica sustains at its decode knee (TPOT within SLO); with peak_prefill_throughput it sizes the opening xP:yD shape.

sessions_per_prefill_engine.description: Closed-loop sessions one prefill engine serves before its prefix cache thrashes (AgentX sizing prior).

sessions_per_decode_engine.description: Closed-loop sessions one decode engine serves with KV headroom (AgentX sizing prior).

source.description: Where this recipe came from (run ids, report paths), and -- when `repo` is set -- the repository the launch script lives in, which an init container clones into `mount_path` (default /workdir) before the engine starts.

repo.description: `owner/name` on GitHub or a full URL.

ref.description: Commit, branch or tag to fetch (default main).

token_secret.description: Secret holding a token for a private repository.

engine_flavor.description: Which connector modules the image carries, as `deploy probe` reports them: tpu-inference's (TPUConnectorHMA / TPUOffloadConnector) or the torchtpu image's own (vllm_torchtpu.*). Picks the kv_connector names the renderer writes for P/D and host-offload arms. `sim` is llm-d-inference-sim: a simulated fleet on CPU nodes that exercises the orchestration (router, pools, LWS groups, P/D via the sidecar, benchmarks) without an accelerator; its `args` are the simulator's own flags.

multihost.description: How a multi-host replica's hosts join up. The renderer places these; it does not know how a given image starts a distributed engine.

worker_command.description: Command the non-leader hosts run (e.g. a ray worker joining LWS_LEADER_ADDRESS, or `sleep infinity` for a simulated group).

env.description: Extra env on every member of a multi-host group (leader and workers).

tokenizer.description: Hugging Face tokenizer id the load generator counts tokens with, when the served model name is not a hub id (a simulated fleet, a private mirror). Defaults to `model`.

launch.description: Present when the engine is started by its own command (a role script that reads env) instead of `vllm serve <args>`. The InferenceX AgentX Qwen3.5 stack is one: `bash benchmarks/multi_node/agentic/<...>_server.sh` with ROLE and ~120 env vars. The renderer places the command, the role's env and the fleet's knobs (through `knobs`); it does not know the script.

command.description: Container command, e.g. ["bash", "benchmarks/multi_node/agentic/qwen3.5_fp8_tpuv7_vllm-disagg_server.sh"]. The renderer adds env ROLE=prefill|decode.

args.description: Container args after the command, when the command still takes flags; knobs mapped to `arg` merge into them.

role_env.description: Env the role needs beyond `recipe.env` (PREFILL_TP, DECODE_TP, MAX_NUM_SEQS_DECODE, MODEL, ...). Knobs override these by name.

ports.description: Ports the script binds per role (InferenceX: prefill 8000, decode 7200 behind the sidecar on 8000).

knobs.description: How each whitelisted engine knob (`engine.*` / `topology.<role>.engine.*` in llmd-config) reaches this engine: an env var the script reads or a flag. A knob the planner proposes without a mapping is refused at render time with ENGINE_KNOB_UNMAPPED. `unit: GiB` writes bytes from a GiB value; `roles` limits a mapping to some roles. Example: {"max_num_seqs": {"env": "MAX_NUM_SEQS_DECODE", "roles": ["decode"]}, "kv_cpu_offload_bytes": {"env": "PREFILL_KV_CPU_OFFLOAD_BYTES", "roles": ["prefill"], "unit": "GiB"}}.

sidecar_args.description: P/D routing-sidecar args when the router images are not v0.11.0; placeholders {port}, {decode_port}, {connector}. The llm-d-router main sidecar takes ["--port={port}", "--model-server-port={decode_port}", "--kv-connector={connector}", "--secure-serving=false"].

readiness_path.description: HTTP path the startup and readiness probes poll (default /health).

startup_timeout_s.description: How long a cold start may take before the pod is restarted (default 7200: a cold TPU compile of a 397B model is ~30 min, longer under a cold cache).

pod.description: Pod pieces the engine needs that the renderer cannot derive: rendered verbatim into the model-server pod after this schema. Written by the person porting a launcher, not by the search.

volumes.description: Extra pod volumes (a ReadOnlyMany weights PVC, a hostPath compile cache, an emptyDir for logs).

volume_mounts.description: Mounts for those volumes on the engine container.

init_containers.description: Init containers run before the engine (sysctls, cache pruning).

privileged.description: Run the engine container privileged with IPC_LOCK, as the TPU launchers do.

security_context.description: Full container securityContext, when `privileged` is not enough.

resources.description: Full container resources, replacing the renderer's defaults (the chip request is added when absent). An engine with hundreds of GB of host RSS must not inherit the default 64Gi limit.

router_images.description: EPP and P/D sidecar images when the pinned v0.11.0 ones will not do: the InferenceX AgentX config is `llm-d.ai/v1` and needs llm-d-router main builds (named by digest in that launcher).

notes.description: Free-text provenance a human wrote next to the numbers (which values are priors, what to confirm before submitting). Never read by the renderer.
